description: This file defines the PovertyLineService interface within the Fineract project, specifying methods for retrieving poverty line data based on different criteria.

classes.name: PovertyLineService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to retrieve poverty line data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all poverty line data for a given PPI name.

methods.name: retrieveForLikelihood
methods.description: Retrieves likelihood-based poverty line data for a specified PPI name and likelihood value.
